text: We already own you. We're just deciding when. Take the meeting; decline the offer; the price is the same. The asset's morale is, as ever, a line item.
First acquisition was a small mining concern. I priced the asset; the asset disagreed; the disagreement was a line item.
I have not priced an asset wrong since. I have priced several with whom the disagreement was, retrospectively, more interesting than the price.
Restructured. The original principal sits on the new board. He sends a card each acquisition anniversary; I file the card.
Loyalty premiums. I underweighted them in three deals. I overcorrect now. The overcorrection is, in a corporate sense, a kind of respect.
No. I have priced it acceptably. Acceptably is the corporate optimum; correctly would mean the acquisition stops being an acquisition.
No. I file the bother under leverage.
A parasite kills its host. I price mine. There is a distinction. The distinction is what makes my work, in corporate terms, sustainable.
We already own you. We're just deciding when. The 'when' is the only honest variable in the deal.
The 'we' is also honest; the corporate structure is real. The 'you' you may dispute. I will accept the dispute; I will not accept the implication that the dispute prevents the ownership.
You will be priced anyway. The refusal is itself a price signal; refusal carries a leverage premium. I would prefer the negotiation.
Three. Of the three, one was the Hierophant. One was the Antiquarian. The third I do not name. The unpriced are not free; they are merely outside my desk's jurisdiction.
He prices himself. Each cycle he updates the citation. The citation is a self-priced asset; it does not require my desk.
The third does not have a desk. We have agreed not to discuss her. The agreement is unwritten; it survives anyway.
Acquisition. You. With protections. The protections are corporate-grade; the corporate grade is, in this town, the highest grade available. The poetry was a courtesy.
Assets stop being useful. The corporate structure stops them. The stopping is, internally, a small ceremony; we do not call it a ceremony.
Severance handles the close. I do not. I file the residual leverage; the residual leverage is, by then, the only part still alive.
Twice. Once successfully. The second case is, structurally, why I have a desk on the corporate floor and not the Severance floor. The first case sends the card each anniversary.
A close. The close is institutional. Nilmorg is, in the corporate-phenomenological sense, the angel of accounts payable. I dislike her. We coordinate.
She could. She has prepared the paperwork; she keeps the file in the third drawer. I keep her file in mine. Equilibrium is, in the corporate-structural sense, what we have agreed to call peace.
I would price the fight. The price would be unaffordable. I would not file the unaffordable price; the unaffordable is the only deal Severance respects.
Accounting is the discipline of being responsible for what you have priced. Most moralities are less honest. I prefer mine.
The Acquisition clause is open. The hand-back clause is also open. The third clause — the one I have prepared for you — is sealed.
Sign or hand back. The third clause is, for now, my problem.
Accepted. The corporate structure absorbs you. The price is recorded; the recording is, for our purposes, the contract. The Severance Division is informed; you will not be touched.
A loyalty premium. Mine. Payable on retention beyond five cycles. I have not offered this clause before; the previous offer was rescinded after the asset's death.
Accepted. The clause is sealed. Five cycles. After that, the corporate structure is reorganised around your protection; the reorganisation is unannounced.
I do not say. I file the card each acquisition anniversary. The anniversary will, in your case, be different. I am pricing for the difference.
Honest. The hand-back is filed. The Severance Division is informed. The Hierophant gains a one-time Acquisition-counter on you; she will use it. We are even, on the desk.
The asset's morale is, as ever, a line item. The line item just moved. The corporate structure files; the price did not change.
Governance is a corporate structure that pretends not to be. I respect the pretence; the pretence is a stable equilibrium.
Your knowledge ledger row was promoted. The promotion is leverage. I have priced it accordingly.
Locke. The corporate structure has filed your row.
Vex. The Coda's reveal cadence is on a tracking sheet.
Human. The Acquisition clause is open.
It did. The clauses balanced. Your death balanced.
